    - All invoices reassigned from fromId to intoId

- SAME_CUSTOMER: when fromId and intoId are the same customer
- CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND: when either customer doesn't exist

- Same customer rejection

- Merge with no invoices
- Multiple invoices from same customer
- Original arrays not mutated
- Mixed customer invoices (some from, some to, some other)
